<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.DebrisTriggerCnr: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Extracts the trigger points of debris flows along the network, with the method of the CNR: a network cell is a trigger if its gradient is steeper than 0.32 x A^-0.2, with A the contributing area in km², below the gradient threshold and with a contributing area below the area threshold. The triggers get the value of their threshold gradient.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Debris flow, Trigger, Network<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.DebrisTriggerCnr`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file | m |  | The map of the elevation. |
| `inNet` | raster file |  |  | The map of the network. |
| `inTca` | raster file | cells |  | The map of the total contributing area, in cells. |
| `pTcathres` | double | km² | `10.0` | The contributing area over which there are no more triggers. |
| `pGradthres` | double | ° | `38.0` | The gradient over which there are no more triggers: steeper channels are rock. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outTriggers` | output file |  | The map of the trigger points, with the value of their threshold gradient. |
